title: Unconstrained S3 endpoint settings in Elasticsearch ES|QL data sources can cause requests containing storage…
description: A vulnerability in Elasticsearch ES|QL data sources allows users with data-source management privileges to configure unconstrained S3 endpoint settings. This misconfiguration can cause requests containing storage credentials to be sent to attacker-controlled hosts. In commercial Elastic Cloud Hosted deployments that have opted in, this issue can also lead to the disclosure of workload-identity tokens, potentially exposing customer cloud resources outside of Elasticsearch. Self-managed deployments are affected only by the storage-endpoint path issue.
